_comment: Copy this file to parasite-skill.json in your project root. All keys optional; CLI flags always win over config values. Config is found by walking up from the current directory.

gc._comment: Artifact retention policy. auto sweeps stale agent reports + ledger entries at scan/export/doctor entry points, at most once per intervalDays. ageDays/keep prune agent artifacts; ledger gives the audit ledger its own independent schedule (falls back to ageDays/keep when absent). CLI knobs on tools gc always win.

env._comment: Per-project env isolation: exposed as ctx.env and baked into generated parasite hooks/wrappers. Never mutates your shell. Values are never exported (key names only).

parasite._comment: Per-project toggle for the enhancement layer: set enabled=false to disable runtime injections in this project entirely.

sets._comment: Project-defined skill-sets, marked (project), override same-named sets, edited only here.
